title: Cancer Clinical Trials Financial Reimbursement Program
official: Enhancement of Access to and Diversity in Cancer Clinical Trials Through a Financial Reimbursement and Outreach Program
summary: To implement a Financial Reimbursement and Outreach Program at clinical sites within the Harold C. Simmons Comprehensive Cancer Center; and evaluate the impact of the program on clinical trial enrollment and demographics, as well as facilitators of and barriers to program participation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be enrolled in a therapeutic cancer clinical trial
* Speak English or Spanish

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not enrolled in a clinical trial
* Does not speak English or Spanish
sponsor: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center

sites.f: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center
